results.title: Fertiliser stocks today: FACT, NFL, Rashtriya Chemicals, Paradeep Phosphates rally up to 17% as Russia offers to boost India supplies
results.description: Fertiliser Stocks Today: Fertiliser stocks gained up to 17% after Russia offered to boost supplies to India. Expectations of uninterrupted fertiliser availability and stronger India-Russia cooperation lifted Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore, Rashtriya Chemicals, National Fertilizers and Paradeep Phosphates.

results.title: Federal Bank Shares Fall 4% On Jana Small Finance Bank Acquisition Reports
results.description: Federal Bank shares fell 4% after reports that the lender is in advanced talks to acquire a controlling stake in Jana Small Finance Bank. Jana SFB’s promoter may sell its 16.9% holding, potentially triggering an open offer. The development comes after Federal Bank reported strong June-quarter earnings
